angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 765,270 km at 188.06 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.3174 +/- 0.0101 mas (same row, RUWE 0.78): 188.06 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.1 +/- 0.13 solar radii from Angelo et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-1656 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..227A/abstract): 765,270 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.03 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Angelo et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-1656 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..227A/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5696 +/- 81.83 K from TICv8, the stellar temperature of Kepler-1656 b's parameter set from TICv8 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: TICv8, the stellar temperature of Kepler-1656 b's parameter set from TICv8 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kepler-1656.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.368, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-1656 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.19 dex, from Fulton & Petigura 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..264F/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-1656 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.02083, from Q1-Q17 DR25 Supplemental KOI Table (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-1656 (pscomppars): age 6.31 Gyr, from Angelo et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..227A/abstract)
